bass.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play a syncopated, palm-muted riff in E minor at 120 BPM. The drum kit features a prominent double-kick pedal pattern and a dry, high-tuned snare. A distorted bass guitar mirrors the guitar riff with aggressive pick attack. The arrangement utilizes a 4/4 time signature. The guitar tone is characterized by high gain and mid-range scoop. Cymbals are used for frequent accents on the off-beats. The track maintains a consistent intensity without dynamic shifts.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff, palm-muted syncopation]
[bass guitar enters, doubling the riff]

[Main Section]
[full drum kit enters, double-kick pedal pattern]
[heavy snare accents on beats 2 and 4]
[crash cymbal hits on phrase transitions]

[Outro]
[sustained power chord]
[feedback fade out]

drums.tags: Drum solo featuring a standard acoustic drum kit. The performance consists of rapid, syncopated snare drum rolls and ghost notes interspersed with heavy kick drum accents. The hi-hat is played tightly closed with occasional open accents on the off-beats. The drummer utilizes a high-velocity sticking technique with frequent rimshots on the snare. The recording has a dry, close-mic'd room aesthetic with minimal artificial reverb. The tempo is 130 BPM in 4/4 time. The kick drum follows a complex, non-repetitive pattern that syncopates against the steady hi-hat pulse. No melodic or harmonic instruments are present.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[rapid snare drum rolls, tight hi-hat eighth notes]

[Main Section]
[syncopated kick drum accents, ghost notes on snare]
[open hi-hat accents on off-beats]
[frequent rimshots]

[Outro]
[final kick drum hit, snare decay]
